uncompressed_error_characterization.observation: On the uncompressed lossless plate, ghost-region MAD is 5.135 with removal-ON (compared to 5.208 with removal-OFF, a delta of only -0.073 MAD). This ~5.14 MAD residual is an OBSERVED error of the current single-homography plate pipeline on this clip, NOT a proven geometric limit of planar homography. The observed error conflates multiple potential factors: non-planar scene geometry/court parallax, camera sensor noise, temporal lighting/shadow changes across frames, feature tracking and homography estimation error, and bilinear warping interpolation. Isolating whether this residual stems from geometric non-planarity vs photometric or sensor noise requires a calibrated 3D multi-plane or multi-camera control (not available here). Therefore, causal attribution to geometric parallax remains an unverified hypothesis.

original_protocol_alarms.diagnostic_disposition: Triggered under protocol bounds [1.0, 6.0]. Diagnosed and explained by error decomposition: the uncompressed plate reconstruction has an observed error of ~5.14 MAD, and VVC QP 47 adds +3.58 MAD compression distortion, placing coded ghost MAD at 8.715. The bound was violated because its expectation of near-zero ghosting assumed mask removal alone would eliminate error.

Triggered under protocol bounds [0.8, 4.5]. Diagnosed and explained by error decomposition: uncompressed plate reconstruction has an observed error of ~5.14 MAD, and VVC QP 32 adds +1.40 MAD compression distortion, placing coded ghost MAD at 6.538. The bound was violated for the same reason as ALARM-01.

rules.promote: ghost MAD reduction >= 50%, vis PSNR loss <= 0.5 dB, byte increase <= 15%
rules.stop: ghost MAD reduction <= 0%, vis PSNR loss > 0.5 dB, byte increase > 15%

pre_registered_protocol_verdict.evaluation: Observed reductions of 4.91% (QP 47) and 2.48% (QP 32) are > 0% but < 50%. Because the pre-registered protocol did not explicitly define a hard stop for the (0%, 20%) band, the original run script evaluated the verdict as INCONCLUSIVE_EXPLORATORY.

later_policy_decision.policy_clarification: Outcomes with ghost MAD reduction < 20% fail the meaningful effect threshold. The minor reduction (2.5% to 4.9%) does not justify the 2.2x to 2.7x sender runtime penalty (from 1.9s to 4.2-5.3s) and pipeline complexity of foreground mask exclusion and inpainting. Removal-ON is therefore formally classified as NOT PROMOTED / REJECTED for PointStream standard pipeline.
